create_boxmasklist: create a BoxMaskList from numpy box coordinates and binary mask arrays
get_masks: get the binary mask array from a BoxMaskList instance
get_boxes: get the box coordinates from a BoxMaskList using the inherited get method
add_field_to_boxmasklist: add a custom field like scores to a BoxMaskList instance
get_coordinates: get individual y_min, x_min, y_max, x_max arrays from a BoxMaskList
